title: Best Yoga Mats in India (2026)
summary: Three Decathlon India yoga mats: light 5 mm, soft 8 mm and grippy 4 mm. Based on shop pages and maker text. Not hand-tested.
description: Helps anyone in India choosing a yoga mat. Three Decathlon picks, plus plain tips on thickness, material, grip and size.
lead: Compare three Decathlon India mats by size, thickness, stated material and carrying weight. The 5 mm listing has conflicting weight figures, which we explain below. We have not tested grip or comfort, so the comparisons distinguish published specifications from our shopping advice.

picks.name: Domyos Yoga Mat 5mm Thick, EVA, 180 x 58 cm, Ultra Lightweight with Carry Strap
picks.label: Suits light carrying
cells: EVA and polyethylene foam (per the page)
Starting out and carrying to class
picks.verdict: A compact 5 mm mat to compare for carrying to class; ask the seller to resolve its conflicting weight figures.
paragraphs: Decathlon lists this EVA mat as 180 x 58 cm and 5 mm thick, with a carry strap. Its description says 600 g, but its specifications show 0.52 kg. Because those figures disagree, we do not give it a single verified weight.

We would compare this mat for carrying to class and for a smaller practice space. Its 58 cm width is narrower than the other two here. The maker describes light grip; we have not tested it with sweaty hands or on different floors.
not_good: The two published weight figures disagree.
The narrowest mat in this comparison.

picks.name: Kimjaly Yoga Mat 8mm Thick, Anti-Slip Foam, 173 x 61 cm with Carry Strap
picks.label: Suits gentle floor work
picks.verdict: An 8 mm mat for gentle practice, with published dimensions and a weight of 1.85 kg.
paragraphs: Decathlon lists the Kimjaly mat as 173 x 61 cm, 8 mm thick and 1.85 kg. It describes PVC foam and positions it for gentle yoga. The title includes a carry strap.

The extra thickness makes this worth comparing when floor comfort is your priority. It is shorter than the other two mats, so check your space when lying down. More padding does not automatically mean a better mat for every standing pose.
good: The thickest of these three options.
Size and weight are both published.
not_good: At 173 cm, it offers less length than the other picks.

It provides the largest practice area of these three mats. That does not establish better grip: we have not compared the surfaces ourselves. Its weight is an important trade-off if you walk or commute to class.

not_good: At 2.5 kg, it is less convenient to carry frequently.

choose.heading: Pick the thickness for your floor and style
choose.text: Decathlon’s guidance suggests thinner mats for dynamic practice and more padding for gentle styles. Match comfort and stability to your own practice rather than assuming the thickest mat is always best.

choose.heading: Know your material
choose.text: The listings describe EVA, PVC foam and rubber with a PU top. Compare the actual surface and care instructions; material names alone do not prove grip, durability or comfort.

choose.heading: Look at the grip
choose.text: Decathlon's guide says a sticky mat keeps you from sliding between poses. The maker calls the 4 mm Kimjaly very grippy and the 5 mm Domyos light grip. If you sweat a lot, grip may matter more to you than thickness.

choose.heading: Check the size if you are tall
choose.text: The three picks are 173 to 185 cm long. Decathlon India also lists a 5 mm mat of 200 x 75 cm that it says is made for taller people.

choose.heading: Think about weight if you carry it
choose.text: The 8 mm mat lists 1.85 kg and the 4 mm mat 2.5 kg. The 5 mm listing disagrees with itself: 600 g in its description and 0.52 kg in its specifications. Ask the seller if carrying weight is decisive.

choose.heading: Check the exact listing before paying
choose.text: Check the current seller listing for availability, delivery to your pincode, returns and warranty coverage before ordering.

faq.q: What thickness of yoga mat should I choose?
faq.a: It depends on your floor and style. Decathlon's guide suggests 3 to 5 mm for dynamic yoga and 5 to 8 mm for gentle yoga. Thicker mats give more padding. But Decathlon says a mat that is too thick can weaken your feel of the floor.

faq.q: Which of these three is the lightest?
faq.a: The 5 mm mat has the lowest listed figures, but they conflict: 600 g and 0.52 kg. The other two list 1.85 kg and 2.5 kg. Confirm the exact model’s weight before ordering.

faq.q: Is a PU top layer more grippy?
faq.a: The maker says the PU top layer on the 4 mm Kimjaly gives maximum grip. That is the maker's claim.

faq.q: What are the return terms on Decathlon India?
faq.a: Terms can change, so read them on the page before you buy.

faq.q: I am tall. Is there a longer mat?
faq.a: Our three picks are 173 to 185 cm long. Decathlon India also lists a 5 mm foam mat of 200 x 75 cm that the maker says is made for taller people.
